---
title: "Section 0: Welcome and Setup"
---

Housekeeping before we start:

- Work on [Posit Cloud](https://posit.cloud/), or your own laptop if you've done the [prework](../index.qmd#workshop-prework).
- You'll need an OpenRouter API key. You should have received one today; if not, let us know.
- Please ask questions, and tell me to slow down if needed. Yani is here to help with the exercises.
- The code for each section is in the **Code** menu above, one script per section.

Run the script below to make sure everything works before Section 1.

[Download `00-welcome-and-setup.R`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thisisnic/ellmer-latinr/main/code/00-welcome-and-setup.R){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-sm} [View on GitHub](https://github.com/thisisnic/ellmer-latinr/blob/main/code/00-welcome-and-setup.R){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-sm}

```{.r filename="code/00-welcome-and-setup.R"}
# 0 - Welcome and Setup
# Using LLMs in R with ellmer - LatinR 2026

## Install the packages we'll use

install.packages(c("ellmer", "dplyr", "readr", "tidyr", "usethis"))

## Add your OpenRouter API key to .Renviron
## (you'll be given a key on the day; ask us if you haven't got one)

usethis::edit_r_environ()

# Add this line to the file that opens, save it, then restart R:
# OPENROUTER_API_KEY=your-key-here

## Check the key is picked up

Sys.getenv("OPENROUTER_API_KEY") != ""

## Check ellmer can talk to the provider

library(ellmer)
chat <- chat_openrouter(model = "anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5")
chat$chat("Say hello in one short sentence.")
```
